title.narrative: Skills 2 Live Phase 2

description.narrative: Drawing from the lessons of the Skills 2 Live pilot project implemented by Young Africa (YA) International Hub from June 2019- December 2020 as well as aligning to the Embassy of the Kingdom of the Netherlands in Maputo Sexual Reproductive Health Rights (SRHR) regional programme, Young Africa International is implementing the Skills 2 Live Phase II project for 6 years (2021- 2026) in Mozambique, Zambia and Zimbabwe. The project seeks to promote sustainable livelihoods, reduce vulnerabilities and enhance resilience of at least 34,540 young people to realise their SRH outcomes in Angola, Mozambique, Zambia, and Zimbabwe through a compendium of economic empowerment, climate change activities integrated to SRHR interventions. It is envisaged that through the project, the following results will be achieved: Result 1: Resilient and empowered YVP have improved livelihoods with entrepreneurship skills and employability options.Result 2: Increased access to, and use of comprehensive HIV, SRHR services

activity-date.narrative: The project started on the 1st of January 2021 and will run until 31 December 2026.
